chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir عليه السلام said:

Hajj and ʿUmrah are two marketplaces from the marketplaces of the Hereafter. Whoever remains devoted to them is among the guests of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. If He keeps him alive, He keeps him without sin; and if He causes him to die, He enters him into Paradise.

key_terms.أَسْوَاقِ الْآخِرَةِ: places of spiritual gain and reward belonging to the Hereafter
key_terms.أَضْيَافِ اللَّهِ: those honored as guests of Allah through pilgrimage
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the final reward for the righteous
key_terms.الْحَجُّ: the major pilgrimage to the Sacred House of Allah
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ: the lesser pilgrimage performed with specific rites
key_terms.ذَنْبَ: sin or moral burden removed by divine grace

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about the virtue of hajj and ʿUmrah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes hajj and ʿUmrah as spiritually profitable acts tied to the Hereafter, not merely worldly travel or ritual movement. It emphasizes the immense honor of the pilgrim as a guest of Allah and promises either continued life free of sin or entry into Paradise upon death.
